hold or lift into it unassisted — range you can use in the air
level_notes: Bands follow the Bodyweight Warrior flexibility ladder: Basics = daily-movement range · Basic+ = prep positions (horse stance, long lunge, loaded Jefferson curl) · Intermediate = 45° pancake, active leg lifts, wall bridge · Advanced = full pike, pancake, bridge, front and middle split · Contortion = oversplits, chest stand, scorpion

skills.name: Know your level (flexibility tests)
skills.how: Run the pike, pancake, bridge, shoulder and split tests once a month and photograph them.
skills.target: Baseline; measures progress so you stop guessing.

skills.name: Dynamic warm-up (leg swings, hip circles)
skills.how: Forward/back and side-to-side leg swings, hip circles, cat-cow — 8–10 min before any deep stretch.
skills.target: Blood flow and joint prep; never stretch cold.

skills.name: PNF / contract-relax method
skills.how: Stretch → contract the stretched muscle 5–10 s against resistance → relax and go deeper. Repeat 3×.
skills.target: Fastest passive-range gains for splits and pike.
skills.dose: 2–3× per week per stretch, not daily.

skills.name: Jefferson Curl
skills.how: Standing on a step, chin to chest, roll down one vertebra at a time holding a light weight; restack to come up.
skills.target: Hamstrings and whole posterior chain under load — the safest strength-stretch.
skills.dose: 3–4 × 5 reps, 10–15 s at the bottom; start with 5 kg or less.

skills.name: Seated forward fold
skills.how: Legs straight, hinge from the hips, chest toward the thighs.
skills.target: Hamstrings, calves, low back.

skills.name: Pike (full forward fold)
skills.how: Straight legs, flat back, chest on thighs — standing and seated versions.
skills.target: The end-goal hamstring position; unlocks Jade, Russian split, Chopsticks.

skills.name: Elevated / weighted pike
skills.how: Feet elevated on a block, light dumbbells in hand, fold and pulse.
skills.target: Loaded end-range for stubborn hamstrings.

skills.name: Couch stretch (hip flexor / quad)
skills.how: Back knee on the floor, rear foot on a couch or wall, squeeze the glute and stay tall.
skills.target: Hip flexors and rectus femoris — the back leg of the split.

skills.name: Half split & long lunge
skills.how: Front leg straight with hips square (half split); then long lunge with femur parallel to the floor.
skills.target: Hamstring of the front leg + hip flexor of the back leg, one at a time.

skills.name: Front split
skills.how: Front leg forward, back leg behind, hips square, both legs straight, hips on the floor.
skills.target: The Jade, Allegra, Russian split shape.
skills.dose: 3–5 × 60 s per side, 4× a week; use blocks under the hands.

skills.name: Oversplit
skills.how: Front foot elevated on a block once the flat split is comfortable.
skills.target: Beyond-180° range for Bird of Paradise, Pegasus, Marchenko.
skills.dose: End of session only, fully warm, 3 × 30 s.

skills.name: Butterfly & Frog
skills.how: Butterfly: soles together, knees toward the floor. Frog: knees wide on the floor, hips sinking back.
skills.target: Adductors and groin — the middle split's engine.

skills.name: Horse stance
skills.how: Wide squat, thighs parallel, knees over ankles — hold and breathe.
skills.target: Active adductor strength in the bent-leg straddle.

skills.name: Pancake
skills.how: Seated straddle, hinge forward with a flat back until the chest reaches the floor.
skills.target: Adductors + hamstrings together; unlocks Chopsticks, Spatchcock, Straddle Bat.
skills.dose: 4–6× a week, 10 min after a 15-min warm-up.

skills.name: Middle split
skills.how: Legs out to the sides in a line, hips forward, torso upright or folded.
skills.target: Spatchcock and Chopsticks; the hardest split for most.

skills.name: Pigeon
skills.how: Front shin across the mat, back leg long, fold over the front leg.
skills.target: Hip external rotation; the fix for pinchy frog and middle split.

skills.name: Cobra · Sphinx · Seal
skills.how: Prone back extensions of increasing depth: forearms (sphinx), hands (cobra), straight arms (seal).
skills.target: Spinal extension warm-up; teaches the back to bend evenly.

skills.name: Thoracic mobility drills
skills.how: Foam-roller extensions, thread-the-needle rotations, reach-backs.
skills.target: Upper-back bend so the lower back doesn't take the whole arch.

skills.name: Camel
skills.how: Kneeling, hips forward, hands to heels, chest to the ceiling.
skills.target: Hip flexors + thoracic extension — the Dove and Eagle shape.

skills.name: Bow / Dancer / King Pigeon
skills.how: Foot-to-hand backbends: bow on the floor, dancer standing, king pigeon kneeling.
skills.target: Shoulder + back + hip flexor together — exactly the Cocoon, Eagle and Marchenko chain.

skills.name: Bridge / Full Wheel
skills.how: Hands and feet on the floor, press up; walk hands toward feet over time.
skills.target: The contortion prerequisite; every deeper backbend starts here.

skills.name: Standing backbend & drop-back
skills.how: From standing, arch back to the wall, then to the floor; stand back up.
skills.target: Control through the full arc — active back strength.
skills.dose: 3–5 reps at the wall, then free with a spotter.

skills.name: Chest stand
skills.how: From bridge, walk feet in until the chest and chin rest on the floor, legs overhead.
skills.target: Marchenko-level back flexibility; needs neck strength work first.
skills.dose: Only after a comfortable bridge; 3 × 20 s with a spotter.

skills.name: Scorpion (forearm stand)
skills.how: Forearm stand with feet dropping toward the head.
skills.target: Shoulder strength + backbend under balance.

skills.name: Wall angels
skills.how: Back and arms on the wall, slide elbows up keeping the low back in contact.
skills.target: Shoulder flexion + thoracic — the test most people fail.

skills.name: Lat & side-body stretch
skills.how: Hands on a counter, sink the chest; side bends holding the pole.
skills.target: Lats — tight lats block overhead reach in Ayesha and inverts.

skills.name: Shoulder & back mobility for pole
skills.how: Pole-specific routine: chest openers, pec stretch, extension work for twisted grip and Cocoon.
skills.target: Twisted-grip safety and backbend shapes.

skills.name: Rear hand clasp (cow-face arms)
skills.how: One arm over, one under, clasp hands behind the back; strap if needed.
skills.target: Shoulder internal + external rotation — Eagle, Cocoon, Allegra grabs.

skills.name: Active flexibility drills
skills.how: Leg lifts, holds and pulses at end range without hands — strength in the stretch.
skills.target: Range you can actually use in the air.

skills.name: Pike compression & L-sit
skills.how: Seated pike pulses, tuck → L-sit progressions, weighted pike pulses.
skills.target: Hip flexor strength for inverts, Chopsticks and press-ups.

skills.name: Standing split
skills.how: Hands on the floor, one leg to the ceiling, hips square.
skills.target: Active front-split line for Bird of Paradise and Russian split.

skills.name: Needle scale
skills.how: Standing split with the back arched and the lifted foot caught overhead.
skills.target: Backbend + split + balance together.

skills.name: Wrist & forearm care
skills.how: Flexor and extensor stretches, wrist circles, rice-bucket or towel grip work.
skills.target: Pole grip endurance and injury prevention.

skills.name: Ankle & foot (pointe and arch)
skills.how: Doming, pointe stretches, arch strengthening — dancer feet.
skills.target: Clean lines in every pole shape; judges look at feet.
